svg.title: CircleCI workflow orchestration outage: WAL saturation and recovery queue
svg.desc: A pipeline request depends on the workflow database. Anti-wraparound autovacuum and application writes generate WAL faster than archival, filling the dedicated log volume. New job dispatch stops; after database recovery, a backlog drains into the execution fleet.
svg.text: The WAL volume filled. Dispatch stopped.
CircleCI described a shared workflow database between pipeline intake and the runner fleet.
Simplified from CircleCI's public postmortem. Timing and counts are attributed in the article.
